purpose: Establish tenant-scoped, versioned CommercialRuleSet and RulePack authority with deterministic pricing and payer decisions that retain immutable rule references.
requiredInvariants: CommercialRuleSet, RulePack and decisions are PostgreSQL-authoritative and tenant-scoped.
Published rule versions and decision records are append-only and retain content hashes.
Pricing uses integer kopecks or basis points and never floating-point money.
The pricing vocabulary is FREE, SUBSCRIPTION, ACCESS_FEE, FIXED, PER_TON, PER_KM, PER_TRIP, PER_HOUR, PERCENT, SUCCESS_FEE, CAPPED_PERCENT, HYBRID and MANUAL_QUOTE.
The payer vocabulary is SELLER, BUYER, INITIATOR, DELIVERY_RESPONSIBLE, SPLIT, CONTRACT_RULE and REQUIRES_CONFIRMATION.
Every evaluation records immutable rule-set and rule-pack version references plus the exact input and output hashes.
Publishing and retiring rule versions require organization-admin authority, CAS versioning, payload-bound idempotency and chained audit/outbox events.
Rule evaluation is deterministic, fail-closed for missing facts and cannot create a financial obligation.
No accounting path, registration path, Deal Engine mutation, paid dependency, external partner access or production activation is introduced.
acceptance: All thirteen pricing models and seven payer modes are represented by exact closed vocabularies.
Draft rules cannot be evaluated and published versions cannot be edited or deleted.
The same version and canonical input produce the same content-addressed decision.
Percent and capped-percent calculations are integer-safe and bounded.
MANUAL_QUOTE and REQUIRES_CONFIRMATION return explicit non-financial pending outcomes.
Exact command replay returns the original receipt and conflicting replay is rejected.
Concurrent publish commands produce one accepted transition and one stale-version result.
Cross-tenant and same-tenant outsider reads and writes are denied under restricted PostgreSQL principals.
A forced audit or outbox failure rolls back rule state and append-only events.
The scope guard confirms no registration, accounting or role-eligibility path changed.
